policy: Scoped lexical chemical-gene candidates in six-query PubMed corpus; rule output requires expert review; no clinical efficacy or validated NER claim
gene_alias_policy: Canonical CTD symbol (case-sensitive) and gene name only; unreviewed source synonyms retained/excluded; clinical terms blocked
source_rights: CTD source terms: citation, source hyperlinks, use notification and periodic access; not a redistribution permission determination
pubmed_abstract_rights: Preserve publisher/original abstract rights; public retrieval does not establish blanket CC0 redistribution
